title: Build something brilliant: AI hack night
description: A hands-on hackathon for curious minds. Explore artificial intelligence, build a software prototype, and meet your next project team. All coding experience levels welcome.

title: Your next chapter starts here
description: Meet alumni and explore internship opportunities in technology, business, and beyond. Bring your questions for a relaxed career networking evening.

title: Ideas to impact: startup social
description: An evening for entrepreneurship, a bold pitch, and new connections. Swap business ideas with student founders over coffee.

title: Beyond the canvas
description: A student arts showcase of photography, painting, and design. Discover a new perspective and connect with creative people across campus.

title: Machine learning, made human
description: An approachable artificial intelligence workshop: learn how algorithms work, explore AI tools, and discuss responsible technology.

title: Finance futures: markets & fintech
description: Explore finance, banking, investments, and the technology reshaping markets. A student-led panel with a friendly Q&A.

title: Small discoveries, big possibilities
description: Discover biology research, genetics, and biotechnology through student laboratory projects. Learn how to get involved in undergraduate research.

title: Good neighbors: community food drive
description: Join a community service afternoon. Volunteer to sort donations, meet fellow students, and help support our neighbors.

title: Pickup basketball & new friends
description: Take a study break with casual basketball, fitness, and friendly competition. All skill levels are welcome to this sports meetup.

title: Robotics from the ground up
description: Build hardware, explore circuits, and try embedded systems programming with a beginner-friendly robotics team.

title: Mind matters: psychology research café
description: Talk psychology, behavior, and neuroscience with students exploring mental health research. A relaxed conversation over coffee.

title: The internship interview lab
description: Practice your interview, polish your resume, and get practical career feedback in small peer groups.

title: Ocean science discovery walk
description: Explore coastal biology and environmental research. Discuss laboratory methods and marine discovery on an accessible campus walk.

title: Open mic, open minds
description: An intimate evening of music, poetry, and student arts. Bring a piece to share or settle in and enjoy the performances.

title: Economics of a changing world
description: Explore economic policy, global trade, and markets with a student-led economics discussion and data analysis activity.

title: Care in action: nursing skills café
description: Explore nursing, patient communication, and healthcare careers through a peer-led clinical skills discussion. Educational demo event only.

title: Math meets the real world
description: Try statistics, mathematics, modeling, and algorithms in a friendly puzzle session. Explore where math and technology connect.

title: Design it. Build it. Test it.
description: A mechanical engineering workshop on CAD, manufacturing, and sustainable design. Collaborate on a small robotics concept.

title: Coffee & connections
description: Meet students from different majors at a relaxed networking meetup. Share your interests and find a new study buddy.

title: Cybersecurity capture the flag
description: Learn cybersecurity fundamentals through programming puzzles in a guided, isolated practice environment. Bring a laptop and curiosity.

title: Sunset soccer social
description: Kick off your weekend with friendly soccer, sports, and fresh air. Join a team on arrival; beginners welcome.

title: Build your first website
description: Learn HTML, CSS, and JavaScript programming. A developer-led coding workshop to bring your first software idea to life.

title: The campus green team
description: A volunteer community service meetup to care for shared campus spaces and brainstorm sustainability projects.

title: From idea to first customer
description: Practice entrepreneurship, marketing, and management. Work through a startup business challenge with a small student team.

title: Find your people: clubs sampler
description: Explore arts, sports, technology, and community service with a relaxed networking afternoon. A welcoming place for undecided students.
